title: Order flow
description: Net size added to bids versus asks as the book updates. It shows which side is building before anyone trades.

ofi_base_10s.label: Flow in 10s
ofi_base_10s.description: Size added to bids minus size added to asks over the last ten seconds, in BTC. Positive means buyers are building faster.

ofi_base_60s.label: Flow in 60s
ofi_base_60s.description: The same net size over the last minute, in BTC. Slower to move but harder to fake.
